craft.description: Build or redesign a responsive web surface. Compatibility alias for the ordinary build flow.

shape.description: Resolve a blocking product and surface decision, then build through the normal build flow.

init.description: Capture durable product truth in PRODUCT.md.

document.description: Record the incumbent visual system in DESIGN.md and its sidecar.

extract.description: Consolidate repeated tokens and component patterns into the existing design system.

critique.description: Review a web interface for UX and visual design quality.

audit.description: Audit accessibility, responsiveness, implementation, and rendered quality.

polish.description: Fix remaining hierarchy, consistency, and interaction defects before shipping.

bolder.description: Amplify the existing visual identity without replacing it.

quieter.description: Reduce visual intensity while preserving identity and task completion.

distill.description: Remove unnecessary complexity from an existing interface.

harden.description: Cover real-world errors, overflow, i18n, and edge states.

onboard.description: Improve first-run flows, empty states, and activation.

colorize.description: Give color a coherent role in hierarchy, action, state, and wayfinding.

typeset.description: Improve type roles, hierarchy, measure, and legibility.

layout.description: Improve composition, spacing, rhythm, and responsive priority.

clarify.description: Improve labels, instructions, errors, empty states, and recovery copy.

adapt.description: Adapt responsive web layouts for viewport, input method, and content pressure.

optimize.description: Diagnose and fix measured web UI performance problems.
